translations.web: You shall do my ordinances. You shall keep my statutes and walk in them. I am Yahweh your God.
translations.bsb: You are to practice My judgments and keep My statutes by walking in them. I am the LORD your God.
translations.kjv: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I am the LORD your God.
translations.asv: Mine ordinances shall ye do, and my statutes shall ye keep, to walk therein: I am Jehovah your God.
